name: The Mouth
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility associated with the mouth, emphasizing that God’s words are unchanging and trustworthy, as He does not lie or repent of His promises (Numbers 23:19). Believers are called to guard their speech carefully, asking the Lord to watch over their words and lips (Psalms 141:3), recognizing that the tongue holds the power of life and death (Proverbs 18:21). The righteous tongue is likened to precious silver, reflecting the value of godly speech (Proverbs 10:20), and God Himself places His words in the mouths of His people to establish His purposes (Isaiah 51:16). Therefore, faithful adherence to God’s commands includes speaking His truth without alteration (Deuteronomy 4:2), underscoring the vital role of the mouth in both obedience and witness.
